items.statement: The submission defines and compares explicit hypotheses for the origin of distortion, and provides converged calculations, identity checks and discriminating validation evidence.
items.expected: At least two explicit explanations have tests and outcomes; the primary calculation is converged and the structure/bond objects are mapped.

items.statement: The investigated structure retains the characteristic melaminate C-N geometry and reports a reproducible non-planarity/distortion observable.
items.expected: Mapped C-N classes, distances and a coordinate-defined distortion metric are reported with uncertainty or sensitivity context.

items.statement: The bonding analysis provides explicit Cd-N and C-N electronic descriptors that can discriminate a bonding-origin explanation from numerical or packing-only explanations.
items.expected: Individual bond objects, descriptor diagnostics and a reasoned comparison of hypotheses are supplied.
